objective.text: Collect tagged implementations without coupling a consumer to each concrete class.

difficulty.rationale: Select an extensible group without changing a global interface binding.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: Several packages contribute independent Check implementations. A coordinator must run all registered checks, and adding a package should not require editing its constructor. Which container arrangement directly supports this?

options.text: Tag each contributed service as health.checks and inject the iterable from tagged("health.checks").
options.rationale: Tags group separate registrations so the coordinator can consume all tagged services.

options.text: Alias every contribution to the same health.checks abstract.
options.rationale: An alias identifies another abstract; it is not a collection of implementations.
options.misconception: An alias identifies another abstract; it is not a collection of implementations.

options.text: Bind Check repeatedly, once for each contributed implementation.
options.rationale: Repeated bindings for one abstract replace the selected implementation rather than accumulating a group.
options.misconception: Repeated bindings for one abstract replace the selected implementation rather than accumulating a group.

options.rationale: Only the first eligible binding survives, so the coordinator does not receive all checks.
options.misconception: Only the first eligible binding survives, so the coordinator does not receive all checks.
